subject: C28
required_fixes: R1 — apps/desktop/src/v2/tenant-switcher.tsx:33–37 and apps/desktop/src/v2/modal.tsx:35–45: Command-T replacing the palette still leaves focus on Go to…. The switcher's focus effect runs while its rail remains inert, so focusing the tenant button fails; removing inert does not rerun that effect, and the palette restores its opener. An inert-aware production-App probe reproduced this ordering, matching native observations.cmd_t_over_palette. Acceptance: in WKWebView, Command-T over the palette focuses a tenant-list control after inert clears; Escape closes the list and focuses Switch tenant without selecting. Cover this ordering in the regression test, which currently passes because jsdom permits focus inside inert ancestors.

R2 — apps/desktop/src/shell/feature-view.tsx:110: the new Use the new interface checkbox discards dispatch's outcome. Through the production App/SettingsView, both deniedStore and DeliveryOutcomeUnknown produced no status, toast or unconfirmed recovery; the checkbox simply kept its observed value. The corrected rail/native-menu preference path does not cover this control. Acceptance: interface-toggle refusals are visibly reported, unknown delivery remains visibly unconfirmed with explicit Retry/Dismiss, observed state remains authoritative, and snapshots/timers never initiate another action. Exercise this new control in both shell variants.

R3 — apps/desktop/src/v2/tenant-switcher.tsx:39,82–99 and apps/desktop/src/styles/tokens.css:103–125: the tenant popup is constrained by absolute left-0/right-0 to the collapsed trigger container, approximately 39px wide inside the 64px rail. Its padded tenant/environment rows cannot fit, and the popup remains inside the rail's overflow container. Collapsing the trigger must not also collapse the tenant-selection surface. Acceptance: below 1280px, including 1180px and the interim 900px minimum at 100%/200% in both themes, the opened popup displays distinguishable tenant names and environments plus Add a tenant, with usable targets and focus indicators and no horizontal rail scrolling/clipping. Retain native evidence with two tenants.

R4 — tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c28.py:207,323,380–383,407–428: the revised configured-tenant fixture invalidates several assertions. N01/N07 require an exact standalone Northwind Health label anywhere in the tree; N04 still expects the no-tenant message; N06 samples the now-absent No tenant yet text. N07 selects controls by horizontal position alone, including three unlabeled window-chrome buttons, and compares both rail coordinates although the requirement concerns horizontal scrolling. These produce failures without establishing the corresponding product defects. Acceptance: assertions inspect the intended controls and fixture state, cover both tenant-free and configured states, sample existing theme text, restrict geometry checks to rail descendants, distinguish horizontal movement from permitted vertical scrolling, and retain a fresh unedited native record and observations.
